context.transcript:
Hi everyone.
The first thing on the agenda this morning is to let you know that there's going to be some maintenance work going on outside our office today.
This afternoon a crew's going to be coming to repaint the lines between parking spaces in the lot in front of the building.
This means that at lunch we're going to need everyone to move their car either to street parking or to the parking garage to the parking garage. on Jefferson Street.
I thank you all in advance for getting this done and I apologize for the late notice.
It wasn't our decision to have this done today.
context.transcript_translation:
大家好。
今天上午议程的第一项是通知大家，我们的办公室外面会进行一些维护工作。
今天下午，一个小组将来重新粉刷建筑物前停车场里停车位之间的线条。
这意味着午餐时我们需要所有人把车移到街道停车位或去停在 Jefferson Street 的地下停车场。
我提前感谢大家的配合，并为通知迟了表示歉意。
这不是我们决定今天进行这项工作的。
